name: Shakehand grip
description: Hold the racket like a handshake: thumb and index finger on the rubber, other fingers wrapped round the handle.

name: Penhold grip
description: Pinch the handle between thumb and index like a pen, with the other fingers curled behind the blade.

name: Forehand swing
description: Backswing, drive through the ball and follow through, keeping the grip steady.

name: Backhand swing
description: Bring the racket across your body and push through the ball with a compact stroke.

name: Wrist snap
description: Add a quick snap of the wrist at the moment of contact for extra spin and speed.

name: Serve toss pinch
description: Hold the ball between thumb and index finger and release it cleanly for the toss.

name: Single key press
description: Press one key with a curved finger, then lift.

name: Five-finger scale
description: Play five neighbouring keys up and back down, one finger per key.

name: C major chord
description: Press thumb, middle finger and little finger together to play C, E and G.

name: Rabbit
description: Index and middle finger up as the ears, thumb tucked over the curled ring and little finger; the ears twitch. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: Talking dog
description: Index, middle and ring finger straight as the upper jaw, little finger curled; the thumb drops to open the mouth. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: Swan
description: Every finger half curled into the swan's head, thumb out straight as the beak; the neck bobs from the wrist. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: Flapping bird
description: Both hands flat with the thumbs tucked in and hooked together; the wrists flap the wings up and down. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: Snail
description: Left hand a fist for the shell, resting on the right hand, whose index and middle finger stand up as the feelers. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter A
description: A fist with the thumb straight up along the side of the index finger. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter B
description: A flat hand, fingers straight and together, the thumb folded across the palm. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter C
description: A cupped hand: every finger and the thumb curved as if round a cup. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter D
description: The index finger straight up; the other fingertips curl round to meet the tip of the thumb. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter E
description: A claw: the fingertips bent down to rest on the thumb across the palm. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter F
description: An okay hand: the thumb and index finger touch in a ring, the other three fingers straight. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter G
description: The index finger and the thumb pointed straight out, the other fingers closed. Palm to the side. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter H
description: The index and middle finger straight and together, pointing sideways, the others closed. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter I
description: The little finger straight up, the others closed under the thumb. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter J
description: The I shape, then a twist of the wrist so the little finger traces the curve of a J. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter K
description: The index and middle finger up in a V, the thumb touching the middle finger. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter L
description: An angle: the thumb and index finger straight, the others closed. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter M
description: The thumb tucked under the first three fingers, which fold over it. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter N
description: The thumb tucked under the first two fingers, which fold over it. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter O
description: A tapered hand: every finger curved to touch the tip of the thumb. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter P
description: The K shape turned so the middle finger points to the floor. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter Q
description: The G shape turned so the thumb and index finger point to the floor. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter R
description: The index and middle finger straight and crossed, the others closed. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter S
description: A fist with the thumb across the front of the fingers. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter T
description: A fist with the thumb tucked under the index finger only. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter U
description: The index and middle finger straight up and together, the others closed. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter V
description: The index and middle finger straight up and spread, the others closed. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter W
description: Three fingers straight up and spread, the thumb holding the little finger down. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter X
description: A hook: the index finger raised and bent, the others closed. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter Y
description: Horns: the thumb and little finger straight out, the others closed. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: ASL letter Z
description: The index finger points and traces a Z in the air: across, down at a slant, across. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: Spell JUNCTION (ASL fingerspelling alphabet)
description: Spell JUNCTION in the ASL fingerspelling alphabet, letter by letter at an even pace, about one letter a second. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: Spell GEPPETTO (ASL fingerspelling alphabet)
description: Spell GEPPETTO in the ASL fingerspelling alphabet, letter by letter at an even pace, about one letter a second. Curls are estimates until an expert records it with the gloves.

name: Pinch
description: Bring the thumb and index finger together, then release.

name: Power grip
description: Close all fingers firmly around an imaginary handle.

name: Point
description: Extend the index finger and curl the rest.

name: Spread
description: Open the hand flat with the fingers straight and apart.

name: Fist
description: Curl every finger into a loose fist.

name: Finger wave
description: Ripple the fingers one after another from thumb to little finger.
